draft_en.subject: The 2-SFP + 8-PoE managed switch you found expensive at $90 - a $71 version
draft_en.body:
Hi Azeem,

We met at ISAF 2025 in Istanbul last October - this picks up what we discussed at the booth.

At the booth the 2 SFP + 8-port PoE managed switch was $90 and you found it expensive. There is a lower-cost version on our Realtek-based commercial line, same port layout (2 x SFP + 8 x Gigabit PoE+, L2 managed, web GUI), model STC-28GPM - $71.0 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity). The unmanaged 2 SFP + 8 PoE unit is $33.2.

One question: shall I add multimode SFP modules to the quote, or do you source optics locally?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
